plan.title: BFA in Illustration
plan.notes: Academy of Art University measures progress in semester UNITS (the school's own term); all courses are 3 units and units are recorded here as credits. Source: the school's official program page (Core Classes carousel + Degree Requirements unit table + named general-education requirements), hand-transcribed 2026-10-01. Each BFA page publishes a 10-course 'Core Classes' carousel and a Degree Requirements table of Core 24 + Sophomore Portfolio 3 + Senior Portfolio 3 + Major 39 + Electives 9 + Liberal Arts 42 = 120 units. To reconcile both as printed, the portfolio-titled carousel courses are applied to the portfolio lines and the remaining 8 form Core 24 (see program-specific note). Major 39 is modeled as 13 'Major Elective' choice slots: the public pages name no specific major electives (they vary by emphasis/specialization and are chosen with an advisor). Electives 9 is 3 generic choice slots. Liberal Arts 42 is the page's named general-education requirements plus 'Liberal Arts Elective' choice slots to reach 42. The school publishes NO term-by-term map and NO course-level prerequisites on its public pages; the 8 semesters below are an editorial 15-unit/semester sequencing and all prereq lists are empty. Degree requirements: minimum grade of C- in all major coursework; minimum 2.0 GPA. Portfolio reconciliation: the page's Core Classes carousel shows 10 courses while its Degree Requirements table lists Core 24. ILL 491 ('Portfolio Preparation and Self Promotion') is applied to the Senior Portfolio line. The page names no sophomore-portfolio course; ILL 232 (Studio 1, the only 200-level course in the carousel) is applied to the Sophomore Portfolio line as an editorial reading so the plan matches the school's published unit table - confirm with an advisor.
